## Fix a tool: <name>

- File: `tools/<slug>.yaml`
- What was wrong → what is right:
- Source that confirms it (official page, changelog, pricing page): <https://…>

**Checklist**
- [ ] Only the fields that changed
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes; no personal data
- [ ] Signed off (`git commit -s`) — DCO 1.1, CC BY 4.0

Note: WonderStack applies descriptive fields (text, tags, links, pricing text) automatically after the merge; changes
to the official URL or the category are applied by an editor.
